column1: # worst = the WORST single page's unsigned |ink|% -- RANK THE TRACK ON THIS ONE
# mean  = the same column averaged over the pages. Below about 0.3 is the raster
#         floor for a text-heavy document and says the document holds no defect.
# abs_ink = the same column SUMMED, so it is weighted by length: a 44-page document
#         at 0.23 a page outranks a one-page chart that is 5.18% wrong, and it is
#         the chart that has the defect. Use it for a track total, not for a ranking.
# signed_ink = sum of the per-page SIGNED ink% column -- decide direction on this one
# drift = pages holding content the reference puts elsewhere. NON-ZERO VOIDS THE INK:
#         those pages are compared against the wrong page, so one lost page reads as
#         hundreds of defects. Explain the pagination before ranking such a row.
